question_zh: 固定 MLPLOB v3 60 日配方下，单纯把有效 epoch 暴露量从 1.32 翻倍到 2.64、5.28，是否改善后续日期排序与多空表现
hypothesis: At the fixed MLPLOB v3 60-day CSZ recipe (raw 12-dim L1-L3 windows, lookback 128, 8 training sample times, CSZ labels, train_std scaling, MSE, Adam 1e-4, batch 32, shuffle sampling, seed 11), one continuous trajectory that doubles the effective-epoch exposure from the current 19,800-step anchor to about 2.64 and 5.28 passes tests whether the anchor is undertrained; only the training amount changes.

budget_only_overrides.model.max_steps: cleared; the pre-registered trajectory steps govern the budget
budget_only_overrides.model.epochs: kept as the upper bound (must exceed the last budget point)
budget_only_overrides.note: budget_points and the exposure declaration are the only intended differences; any other deviation from the recipe config must fail the run guard

budget_points.name: anchor-1.32
budget_points.role: current 19,800-step baseline exposure (reference, not a new run)

exposure.reconcile: samples_seen == steps * batch_size; unique/usable coverage >= min_coverage; realised effective epochs within atol of the declared point

resume.fail_closed: pool, recipe, fitted transforms and sampler batch order must reproduce the checkpoint exactly
resume.note: the three budget points are checkpoints of one uninterrupted trajectory, not three independent runs

derived_reference.note: reference only: the driver re-derives steps from the pool actually built at run time, and records them before training starts

cloud.gpu_class: 24GB (platform caliber; training itself is not memory-capped)

decision.rule: retain the longer trajectory only if a later-date paired RankIC gain clears the pre-registered B4 gate (0.0034) with a 5-day block interval excluding zero and no turnover ceiling breach; otherwise report the anchor as sufficient

sealed_final: not read: budget points are evaluated on the validation split only

metric_units.effective_epochs: samples fed to the optimizer / usable training samples
metric_units.coverage: unique training rows seen / usable training rows

evaluation_scope.cloud: validation split 2023-11-01..2023-11-15 = 10 trading days, process diagnostic only
evaluation_scope.formal: the five declared windows (104 trading days) produced locally by replaying the exported per-budget-point weights; a cloud validation score is never the delivery evidence
evaluation_scope.export: each budget point exports modified_tlob_weights-<point>.json (TLOBAdapter text checkpoint) that scripts/replay_model_versions.py loads directly
